name: Agriculture Sustainability Through Plant Associated Microbiomes
description: Engineering and use of beneficial microbes and microbiomes in agriculture as an alternative to chemical pesticides and fertilizers. Identification, development, and utilization of microbial inoculants to enhance plant growth, improve soil health, and protect crops from pests and diseases. Challenges and limitations in the application of microbes and microbiomes-based solutions in agriculture, and identification of ways to mitigate these challenges. Future trends and potentials in areas such as genetic engineering of microbes and microbiome, use of synthetic communities, and smarter screening methods
